# OSGi Configuration Mapper

> A runtime OSGi bundle that centralizes configuration management by distributing values from a single configset file to multiple OSGi components through Freemarker templates.

Key facts:
- Java 21, packaged as an OSGi bundle
- Maven 3.9.4 build with Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`), single-module project
- OSGi Declarative Services, ConfigurationAdmin, Freemarker 2.3.28, JAXB, Guava, Lombok
- Monitors bundles for `.template` files and pushes rendered configurations via ConfigurationAdmin
- Supports OSGi properties, environment variables, and JVM system properties with configurable precedence
- Integration tests use PAX Exam with Apache Felix 5.6.12
- License: Apache 2.0

## Source — OSGi Component Layer

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/DefaultTemplatedConfigSet.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/DefaultTemplatedConfigSet.java): DS component entry point, activates on configset-*.cfg, wires ConfigurationAdmin and creates handler/tracker
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/DefaultTemplatedConfigSetConfig.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/DefaultTemplatedConfigSetConfig.java): OSGi MetaType config interface defining templatePath, envPrefix, and variableScopePrecedence

## Source — Core Logic

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/OsgiTemplatedConfigurationSetHandler.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/OsgiTemplatedConfigurationSetHandler.java): Processes templates, manages OSGi configurations via ConfigurationAdmin, tracks changes with SHA1 checksums
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/TemplateProcessor.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/TemplateProcessor.java): Freemarker template engine with variable scope merging, conditional evaluation, and PID resolution
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/TemplateResourceBundleTracker.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/TemplateResourceBundleTracker.java): Monitors active bundles for template resources and triggers config processing on bundle changes
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/ExtensibleBundleTracker.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/ExtensibleBundleTracker.java): Generic async bundle tracker with single-threaded executor to prevent platform thread leaks

## Source — Data Model and Utilities

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/ConfigurationEntry.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/ConfigurationEntry.java): Builder POJO representing a template with optional XML spec and instance name
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/ConfigState.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/ConfigState.java): Enum for configuration states (UNCHANGED, NEW, FOREIGN, CHECKSUMCHANGE)
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/Utils.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/configuration/mapper/Utils.java): SHA1 hashing, Dictionary-to-Map conversion, properties loading, PID parsing

## Source — Schema and Bindings

- [src/main/resources/configuration_mapper_v1.xsd](src/main/resources/configuration_mapper_v1.xsd): XML schema for extension files defining factory PIDs and conditions
- [src/main/bindings/SkipElementProperties.xjc](src/main/bindings/SkipElementProperties.xjc): JAXB binding customizations for XSD code generation

## Optional

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Maven build configuration with dependencies, profiles, and plugin management
- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI/CD pipeline
